{{Quote|We have rebel scum bolting from their hole! Stop them, Mu 1!|An Imperial officer, ordering Mu 1 to battle the Rebels leaving ''Pi''|<ref name="TIE">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>}}
'''Mu 1''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of an [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboat]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that targeted the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Class-D cargo container]] [[Pi (Class-D cargo container)|''Pi'']] alongside the [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]] [[Scythis (IPV-1 System Patrol Craft)|''Scythis'']].

The battle was later included as part of an Imperial [[Flight simulator/Legends|flight simulator]] training [[TIE pilot|pilots]] to use [[Gunboat/Legends|gunboats]]. Soon after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] was among the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] trainees.<ref name="TIE" />
